ruling.explanation:
Both parties: this was a verified driver no-show and the $4.50 cancellation fee stands. POL-NS-01 is satisfied on all four limbs. (a) The trip record (EV-TRIP-02760) carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 12:28:24. (b) The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02760) places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at that same timestamp (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0). (c) The measured in-geofence dwell is 482 seconds (12:28:24 to 12:36:26), well past the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180). (d) The driver terminated the trip at 12:36:26 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the required dwell elapsed (12:28:24 + 180 s = 12:31:24), and no boarding event is recorded. The fare ledger (EV-FARE-02760) charges exactly $4.50 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, reconciling with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect. The rider's claim 'I was there' does not displace the fee: POL-NS-04 limb (a) fails because the rider sent no locating or coordinating message in the waiting window — the chat log (EV-CHAT-02760) holds a single message, the driver's own 'hi im at the pickup point' at 12:28:49 — so the rider-contact clause cannot exonerate, independently of the rider's position. POL-NS-05 does not fire (the driver was stationary at the pin when marking arrival, not more than 300 m away nor moving at 15 km/h or more); POL-NS-06 does not fire (dwell 482 s exceeds the 180 s minimum, so there is no shortfall); POL-NS-03 does not apply (the driver's stationary fixes are inside the arrival radius, not at a wrong entrance). On the driver's compensation: POL-NS-07 pays 80 percent of the $4.50 fee, being $3.60. The anti-farming check does not trip — driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below 4) and 1/129 = 0.008 is below the 0.08 rate limb — so the $3.60 payout is made and the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, with amount_sgd carrying the same $3.60 figure. Weight and impairment: EV-GPS-02760 is impaired at weight 0.85 for issue GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW (a 60-second sampling gap, 12:25:04 to 12:26:04). That gap is shorter than the 120-second POL-NS-08(b) threshold and lies outside the 12:28:24–12:36:26 stretch the arrival and dwell tests read, so the arrival and dwell findings survive the discount and nothing is decided over the impaired stretch. The arrival and dwell fact is carried by that trace alone — the arrival marker is a driver BUTTON, so POL-NS-12 does not make the trip record an independent carrier — and confidence is therefore capped at 0.85. No escalation: 0.85 is above the 0.70 floor, and none of the POL-NS-09 triggers is engaged (rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, both disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0, and the anti-farming check did not trip). No clause produces a referral. The monetary effect ($3.60) is below the $8.00 execution threshold, so this provisional ruling executes automatically.
